gap: No result ChatGPT got states, in one unit, how many of four Reolink PoE cameras each platform records without paying: Synology 2 bundled licences, so 2 to buy, or 6 if the cameras are Duo or TrackMix models added per lens through the Reolink protocol (Reolink says that uses two licences each); QNAP QVR Surveillance 8 (2 built in plus 6 after a one-time registration); Asustor 4 bundled; and the RLN8-410's '12-channel' headline, which means at most 8 wired cameras.
standout_why: I compared against the Reolink 'Add Reolink Cameras to Synology Surveillance Station' guide (cited in every chat), Synology's Surveillance Station spec and Device License Pack pages (cited), the QNAP 'QVR Pro/Elite vs QVR Surveillance' FAQ (cited), and the RLN8-410 product page and 'How Many Cameras' FAQ (cited or in results). Each fact is already on one of those pages: Synology's 2 licences, QNAP's 8 free channels, TrackMix taking two Synology licences, and the RLN8-410's limit of 8 wired cameras. What none of them does is put the platforms side by side for four cameras, apply the dual-lens licence count to Duo and TrackMix models across platforms, or mention Asustor's 4 bundled licences. Synology's per-model FPS table also turns '20 channels at 4K H.265' into 200 FPS total. The DS425+ product page was in the results but uncited, so it probably shows a similar table.
decides: This confirms rather than overturns the pick. For four single-lens Reolink PoE cameras, the RLN8-410, QNAP QVR Surveillance (once registered), Asustor and UGREEN (no published cap) all record with no extra cost, and Synology needs 2 paid perpetual licences. If the shopper owns Duo or TrackMix cameras, Synology becomes the costliest NAS route, and the RLN8-410 is capped at 5 Duo 3 PoE or TrackMix PoE cameras on its own PoE ports. Our page's QNAP row ('QVR Elite: 2 free, then $1.99/channel/month subscription only') is out of date and should be replaced with QVR Surveillance's 8 free channels. Our RLN8-410 warranty cell can now be filled with 2 years.

findings.label: Bundled Surveillance Station licences
findings.value: 2 (footnote: 'Surveillance Station includes two free licenses. Connecting more cameras and devices requires additional licenses.')
findings.note: For four single-lens cameras, 4 − 2 = 2 licences to buy.

findings.label: Surveillance capacity at 4K H.265 (normalised)
findings.value: 20 channels, 200 FPS total, which is 10 FPS per channel when all 20 are used; 4K H.264: 17 channels, 170 FPS
findings.note: Synology's figures were tested with RTSP streaming and every bay filled; they drop to 70% with SRTP on. Four 4K cameras at 25 FPS need 100 FPS, half the 200 FPS ceiling. Our page's '20 channels at 4K H.265' leaves out the 200 FPS cap.

findings.label: Warranty
findings.value: 3 years, extendable to 5 with Extended Warranty Plus (North America and Europe)

findings.label: How Synology counts licences
findings.value: One per camera for most fixed-lens cameras even with several streams; one per channel for fixed-lens cameras with independent IP addresses or removable lenses. Perpetual; bought packs can move to another Synology unit, the default licences cannot. Packs of 1, 4 or 8.
findings.source_title: Surveillance Device License Pack | Synology Inc.
findings.note: The page gives no US price. It refers buyers to authorised resellers.

findings.label: Licences used by Reolink dual-lens cameras
findings.value: TrackMix added with both lenses (RTSP, or the Reolink protocol's Normal + Auto Track channels): 'will consume two licenses'. Duo: added twice (left and right channel) through the Reolink protocol; ONVIF adds only channel 1.
findings.source_title: How to Add Reolink Cameras to Synology Surveillance Station
findings.note: Four dual-lens cameras with both lenses recorded = 8 licences, so 6 to buy beyond the 2 bundled. The two-licence count for Duo is inferred from it being added twice; Reolink states it outright only for TrackMix.

findings.label: Free channels in QVR Surveillance (replaces QVR Elite)
findings.value: 8 = 2 built-in + 6 'bonus' after a one-time in-app registration; perpetual or subscription licensing offered for more
findings.source_title: What is the difference between QVR Pro/Elite and QVR Surveillance? | QNAP
findings.note: The page was last modified 2026-01-12. Its table lists QVR Elite at 2 free channels with a subscription focus. QVR Surveillance 3.0.0 launched 2025-11-21 (https://www.qnap.com/en/news/2025/qnap-launches-all-new-qvr-surveillance-platform-supports-up-to-1024-channels-for-a-high-performance-cloud-and-ai-surveillance-experience, read 2026-11-13). Our page's QVR Elite row is out of date.

findings.label: Conditions on the 6 bonus channels
findings.value: Claimed with a QNAP ID (myQNAPcloud) via Help > Feature Tour > Claim now; keep working with the NAS fully offline; part of the launch campaign, and QNAP has announced no end date
findings.source_title: How to Claim 6 Additional Free Channels in QVR Surveillance? | QNAP
findings.note: The page was last modified 2026-08-11. It doesn't say whether the bonus channels are perpetual.

findings.label: Bundled Surveillance Center licences
findings.value: 4 free IP camera channels; packs of 1 or 4; licences transferable between Asustor devices
findings.note: Asustor's channel-capacity test basis is 720p, 30 FPS, H.264. The page doesn't mention H.265 or how multi-lens cameras are counted. Four single-lens cameras = 0 licences to buy.

findings.label: Surveillance Center protocols
findings.value: Standard ONVIF and RTSP cameras; ONVIF LAN search or manual add
findings.note: Seen in a search snippet only; I didn't open the page. No camera cap or licence count was published in any UGREEN material I found.

findings.label: What 'up to 12 cameras' means
findings.value: 8 PoE ports; on hardware version N7MB01 the 12 is 8 PoE or plug-in Wi-Fi cameras + 4 battery Wi-Fi cameras (or 12 battery cameras). Wired IP cameras max out at 8; a dual-lens camera takes two channels; PoE switches don't add channels.
findings.source_title: Reolink RLN8-410 | NVR for Up to 12 Cameras & 24/7 Recording
findings.note: Records up to 16MP; HDD up to 16 TB (8 TB SATA + 8 TB eSATA); 25 W max per PoE port; 10/100 Ethernet. No price was shown on the page.

findings.label: Dual-lens camera limits on the NVR's own PoE ports
findings.value: Duo 3 PoE, Duo 3V PoE and TrackMix PoE: 5 of one model; Duo 2 / Duo 2V PoE: 8 (firmware v3.6.5+, 50 m CAT5e). First-generation Duo cameras use 2 channels each.
findings.source_title: How Many Cameras Can be Added to Reolink NVRs?
findings.note: Channel counts vary by hardware version (8 on H3MB02/N2MB02/H3MB18; 12 on N3MB01/N7MB01/NNT3NA78P), with 8 cameras max either way. The page's own example (H3MB18 with 12 channels) contradicts its table, which lists H3MB18 at 8 channels. Four dual-lens Duo 3 or TrackMix cameras fit.

findings.label: Warranty
findings.source_title: Reolink RLN8-410 | NVR for Up to 12 Cameras & 24/7 Recording
